name: Munchi Tempo
description: CHOMPI TEMPO 1.0 on Move: a groovebox with chromatic and slice sample engines, a pattern generator for each, a clock-synced delay and diffusion reverb, A/B snapshots and 28 factory samples. Takes over Move until you exit.
author: CHOMPI Club / Chase Bliss (CHOMPI TEMPO, MIT) · port: charlesvestal
